title: Strengthen the second step of immediate_revocation_covers_current_and_runtime_installed_engram_descriptors
outcome: After the grant clear, the test shows that the clear itself re-targeted every live descriptor tuple (the current old-home grant and the runtime-installed older grant) instead of only re-reading ledger entries the first rotation had already confirmed, for example through a test hook recording the targets each call to revoke_project_engram_authority_off_lock settles.
acceptance: Strengthen the second step of immediate_revocation_covers_current_and_runtime_installed_engram_descriptors is done
